questions.label: What is the business called?
questions.reason: I need to identify the right business, not infer it from a similar name.

questions.label: What is your website?
questions.reason: This lets me research existing facts and avoid asking you to repeat them. Leave it blank when there is no website.

questions.label: Which service or product should this page promote?
questions.reason: This determines the offer, examples and qualification questions.

questions.label: Who is the page for?
questions.reason: The copy should speak to the actual customer's needs.

questions.label: Where do you serve customers?
questions.reason: Use a service area, country, or say worldwide when that is accurate.

questions.label: What are you offering this customer?
questions.reason: I will not invent a discount, guarantee or service promise.

questions.label: What should visitors do next?
questions.reason: This preserves the intended customer journey and selects only the tools it needs.

options.label: Send an enquiry to a private lead inbox

questions.label: Where should that action lead?
questions.reason: Booking, buying, calling or downloading needs a real destination; a placeholder cannot pass launch checks.

questions.label: What happens after someone enquires?
questions.reason: Confirm who responds and any timing you can genuinely promise.

questions.label: Who handles enquiries?
questions.reason: This belongs in the owner handoff, not as invented public copy.

questions.label: Primary action wording
questions.reason: The guide proposes this from the selected action; you can edit it.

questions.label: Which address should the public page use?
questions.reason: A temporary provider address will not silently replace a requested custom address.

questions.label: Which address should the private lead inbox use?
questions.reason: Use only a domain you control; the guide preserves existing DNS and email.
